verified.system: LoCoMo paper Table 3 (RAG, DRAGON retriever, gpt-3.5-turbo-16k reader)
verified.correct_statement: All values match Table 3, including the '247.4' typo (dialog top-10 multi-hop recall) and the per-category dialog k=50 recalls 90.4/75.5/97.3/67.9/77.7. In official code (task_eval/evaluation.py) recall is per-question fractional evidence recall: the share of gold dia_ids present in the retrieved context ids, or the share of evidence sessions present when the retrieved ids start with 'S'. It is averaged over all questions, and a question gets recall 1 when it has empty evidence or no retrieved context. It is neither recall_any nor recall_all. Overall includes adversarial.

verified.claim_as_reported: Normalization + Porter-stemmed token F1; cat1 comma-split multi-answer F1; cat3 truncated at ';'; cat5 keyword match; recall = fraction of evidence dia_ids; empty evidence = 1; defaults top-k 5, contriever
verified.correct_statement: Confirmed in code. normalize_answer removes commas, lowercases, strips punctuation, removes a/an/the/and, and collapses whitespace; f1_score Porter-stems tokens. Cat 1 uses f1(), which splits both sides on ',' and averages over gold parts the max F1 against any predicted part. Cat 3 gold is split on ';'[0]. Cat 5 scores 1 if the output contains 'no information available' or 'not mentioned'. Recall is fractional over evidence ids, at session level when retrieved ids start with 'S', and is 1 when evidence is empty. evaluate_qa.py defaults: --top-k 5, --retriever contriever. has_answer/eval_recall is answer-string containment, not evidence recall. gpt_utils cat-5 multiple choice uses qa['answer'] (the audit reports it is missing on 444/446 cat-5 items; I did not recount).
